reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab report behind a QR code plus a 24.99 launch price makes it an easy one-box try from the TikTok cart. The pre-counted evening sachets are handy too.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? I also have no idea if bisglycinate alone is what my doctor meant.
would_change_my_mind: If a quick check showed the lab report did not match the batch number on the box, or if my doctor said one form is not enough.
